faq.q: What song plays as Jason and Lucia head to the bar in GTA 6?
faq.a: Captain & Tennille's 1980 track "But I Think It's a Dream" plays there. It runs from roughly 9:49 to 10:38 in the Netflix Extended Look, as Jason and Lucia head toward a bar to meet Brian and Lori.

faq.q: What album is But I Think It's a Dream from?
faq.a: It comes from Captain & Tennille's 1980 album Keeping Our Love Warm. The song was identified by GameRant in its timestamped breakdown of the GTA VI Netflix Extended Look.

faq.q: Who are Jason and Lucia meeting during this song in GTA 6?
faq.a: Brian and Lori. The scene shows Jason and Lucia heading toward a bar to meet these two supporting characters while the song plays.

faq.q: When did this song first appear in GTA 6 footage?
faq.a: It appeared in the Netflix Extended Look, a 26 minute gameplay preview that premiered on August 27, 2026. GameRant documented the placement with a timestamp a day later.

faq.q: Is But I Think It's a Dream confirmed for the in-game radio in GTA 6?
faq.a: That has not been stated in the record here. This entry only documents the song's placement in the Netflix Extended Look preview, not whether it appears on any in-game radio station.
